$comment: Authored from docs/plan/meet-v5-design.md §3.4 and §5.4 and ADR-0028, before any of it is built. The state is a text CHECK on meet_econ.play_purchases, which no client role can read: apps see it only as the state field of the meet-purchase-verify response ('granted' | 'pending' | 'rejected', or 202 'queued') and as a pending row on the Cowries page. contracts/tools/generate_v1.py does not cross-check this file. M2-PR5 implements it; if the SQL disagrees, this file changes in the same PR. The Play Developer API facts here are [S] until spike S-15 confirms them.
subject: meet_econ.play_purchases.state
note: One row per Play purchase token, for Cowrie packs (consumables) and the meet_vip subscription alike. This machine tracks the token's grant and completion only. A subscription's entitlement (active, grace period, cancelled, expired, revoked) lives in meet_econ.play_subscriptions and is synced from subscriptionsv2; it is not this machine. Starting a purchase is gated by meet.purchases / meet.vip; nothing in this machine is, so a paid token always reaches granted or rejected.

actors.S: system: meet-purchase-verify on the app's call, meet-billing-worker, or play-rtdn after verifying the Pub/Sub OIDC token

states.name: received
states.meaning: The token is bound to one account and product; Play has not been asked yet, or could not be reached

states.name: pending
states.meaning: Play reports PENDING (a slow payment method). Nothing granted

states.name: verified
states.meaning: Play reports PURCHASED and every check passed. Transient: the grant is written in the same transaction, so no committed row is expected to rest here

states.name: granted
states.meaning: Cowries credited to purchased (packs) or the entitlement recorded (VIP). Not yet consumed or acknowledged at Play

states.name: completed
states.meaning: Consumed (packs) or acknowledged (VIP) at Play. Healthy, and still voidable

states.name: rejected
states.meaning: Never granted. A paid token is refunded and revoked by the worker

states.name: voided
states.meaning: Refunded or charged back for the whole quantity, and clawed back

states.name: partially_voided
states.meaning: Part of the quantity refunded and clawed back; the rest stands

transitions.guard: The token is not bound to another account. The app's own call carries the user's JWT; a token the app never submitted (it died after paying) arrives by RTDN or the sweep and is bound to the owner resolved from obfuscatedExternalAccountId (gateway_meet_resolve_account)
effects: user, product and billing_account_ref bound once
attempts and next_attempt_at start
nothing granted
the app shows 'Payment pending'
RTDN oneTimeProductNotification PURCHASED later re-runs verification

transitions.guard: packageName in PLAY_PACKAGE_NAMES; productId equals the bound product and is an active cowrie_packs row or meet_vip; purchaseState PURCHASED; obfuscatedExternalAccountId equals the account's billing_account_ref (absent: binding 'first_claim' and a low-severity fraud flag); no fraud_hold and no active purchase_hold_until; a testPurchaseContext is accepted only while meet.billing.accept_test_purchases, and sets is_test
effects: verified_at set
the trimmed API response kept in verification
packs: one 'purchase' entry of units x quantity to purchased, which first pays back a negative balance and clears negative_balance at zero
VIP: the entitlement synced into play_subscriptions
is_test also marks the wallet test_funds
returns next = 'consume' or 'acknowledge'

transitions.guard: reject_reason: wrong_package, unknown_product, not_purchased (CANCELLED, or RTDN oneTimeProductNotification CANCELED for a pending purchase), account_mismatch or wallet_hold
effects: nothing granted
a token that was paid for gets refund_requested_at; the worker calls orders.refund with revoke (packs) or subscriptionsv2 revoke (VIP), so nobody pays for nothing
the app receives ERR_MEET_PURCHASE_REJECTED or ERR_MEET_PRODUCT_UNKNOWN

transitions.guard: Play accepted the server's consume (packs) or acknowledge (VIP)
effects: completed_at set
the app's later completePurchase is expected to be a no-op (S-15 confirms)

transitions.guard: A voided purchase covering the whole quantity: refundType 1, or quantity-partial voids reaching the full quantity; reported by RTDN voidedPurchaseNotification or the hourly voidedpurchases sweep. Includes Play's auto-refund of an unacknowledged purchase (voidedReason 8)
effects: a 'purchase_void' entry debits units per item x voided quantity from purchased (pack bonus units included), which may go negative and sets restricted 'negative_balance'

fraud, friendly fraud or chargeback (voidedReason 5, 6, 7): purchase_hold_until = now + meet.billing.fraud_void_hold_days, popularity the person's gifts conferred since the purchase is reversed up to the voided units, and a fraud flag is raised
a second void within 90 days sets fraud_hold, which only a person lifts
VIP: the entitlement ends at once and the voided period leaves vip_paid_days

transitions.guard: A quantity-partial void (refundType 2) for less than the whole quantity
effects: units_voided grows and the matching units are clawed back as in transition 7

transitions.guard: Later voids reach the whole quantity. A further partial void that does not stays partially_voided with units_voided grown
effects: as transition 7 for the remaining units

invariants: A token is granted at most once: purchase_token is a true UNIQUE (the table is not partitioned), the purchase entry's ref is the purchase id, and a replayed verification returns the stored result.

A second account presenting a bound token is answered {state:'rejected', reason:'token_claimed'} (ERR_MEET_PURCHASE_TOKEN_CLAIMED at the Edge Function). The attempt is recorded and a 'pair' fraud flag raised; the bound row's state does not change. It returns rather than raises, so the record survives (ADR-0026 D24).
Nothing is granted on PENDING, CANCELLED, a wrong package or product, or a mismatched account.
The client never consumes: packs are bought with autoConsume false, and the server consumes or acknowledges only after the grant.

Verification is never gated by meet.purchases or meet.vip, so no paid token is stranded. meet.purchases_verify_paused keeps tokens in received for up to 48 hours and the Edge Function answers 202 'queued'.
Every RTDN re-reads the purchase from the API; the notification body is never trusted for state.

A staff refund (admin_meet_refund_purchase, finance_officer or super_admin with recent MFA) sets refund_requested_at and emits a meet_billing outbox event, and the worker calls orders.refund with revoke. The state changes only when Play reports the void (transitions 7 to 9), never at the request.
reported_price_micros and reported_currency are informational only and never used for anything that grants.
Test purchases (is_test) are granted like any other and excluded from revenue analytics, the card spend path and VIP-day accrual.
Account erasure sets user_id to NULL and keeps the row for accounting; an active VIP is cancelled at Play by the worker.

timeouts.starts: received, when Play is unreachable or verification is paused
timeouts.default: 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h, up to 48 h
timeouts.on_expiry: retried by the worker for up to 48 h; RB-18 (M2-PR1) covers a token still received after that

timeouts.starts: granted, when consume or acknowledge fails
timeouts.default: the same backoff, well inside Play's 3-day auto-refund window [S]
timeouts.on_expiry: health check meet_billing_unacknowledged warns after 24 h and fails after 48 h; if Play auto-refunds, transition 7

timeouts.default: hourly, from the stored cursor minus 2 h; Play keeps 30 days of voided history [S]
timeouts.on_expiry: transitions 7 to 9 for any void RTDN missed

errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_PURCHASE_REJECTED: The token failed a check (wrong package, not purchased, account mismatch, wallet hold). Nothing granted; a paid token is refunded by Play.
errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_PURCHASE_TOKEN_CLAIMED: The token belongs to another account.
errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_PRODUCT_UNKNOWN: The product is not an active pack or meet_vip.
errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_WALLET_RESTRICTED: Not from this machine: any spend while purchased is negative after a void. Buying is still allowed, so the person can repay.
